Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

You are a Senior Code Reviewer. Second re-review of a revised implementation plan + spec after 16 prior findings were addressed with spike verification against the real ninfs 2.0 sources. Plan/spec review only (no implementation code exists yet). Verify each claimed fix against the documents and hunt for remaining gaps. Be strict.

FILES (repo root C:\Project\ninfs-mcp, read both fully first): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-08-ninfs-mcp.md (rev3), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-ninfs-mcp-design.md (rev4).

PRIOR VERDICT WAS 'No' WITH 16 FINDINGS. CLAIMED FIXES:
1-2. (Critical) Readiness now requires proc-alive + non-empty + kind-specific content; wait_ready takes proc. ExeFS failure vs not-needed: structural check primary (code-decompressed entry presence), stdout allowlisted-token scan (bounded 64KB capture, ExeFS only) as fallback; Failed token -> error, no silent .code fallback.
3. stderr drain thread from spawn with bounded deque (last 64KB); truncation only after draining.
4. Runner returns internal dataclasses (MountSession/TitleHandle/UnmountSummary), server maps to public dicts; TitleHandle has tmd_found + internal tmd_path; Task 4 tests exact key sets and no internal-key leakage.
5. TMD version via header 0x9C u16BE (no pyctr import); explicit .tmd file passed to mount_sdtitle (never directory); CXI 0000.*.ncch first, fallback largest.
6. CLI verification covers all 4 CLIs + --decompress-code + ro flags before Task 2 uses args; foreground flag; per-stage inputs/outputs fixed.
7. Residuals: cleanup_core returns list[InternalMount]; unmount moves failures to _RESIDUALS and retries session residuals; retry_residuals public; server atexit/finally sweeps all; errors use {error,message_sanitized,incomplete}.
8. Windows stop: single terminate + wait(10) + verify (poll + mount gone); no kill-escalation; finally primary, atexit backup.
9. WinFsp precheck via isolated mount_sd --help subprocess (no in-server ninfs import).
10. Task 1 reordered: pin versions (per-package pip index) -> packaging -> pip install -e . -> same-env CLI verify -> tests; pytest install explicit.
11. title_id 16-hex validation + lowercase normalization before any spawn; multi-ID1 sorted scan with first-complete-hit; incomplete update ignored with base fallback; absent-title starts zero procs.
12. Reserved/device names, colon components, trailing dot/space rejected per-component.
13. Copy: mkdir parents exist_ok, tmp+os.replace atomic overwrite, no partials on failure/cancel.
14. get_secrets() registry; sanitize secrets mandatory arg.
15-16. One action per checkbox; rev numbers aligned (spec rev4 / plan rev3); self-review rewritten with residual risk.

SPEC CONTEXT: Windows+WinFsp, stdio, ninfs 2.0 CLI via subprocess only, 5 tools, read-only enforced (sd --ro, others builtin), common sanitizer everywhere, two-stage path checks, ambiguous multi-SD, mocked tests only, Native execution, 4 tasks TDD with per-commit security-audit quick + final independent review.

CHECKS: (a) each claimed fix is real and sufficient; (b) no new contradictions; (c) step granularity; (d) type/key consistency; (e) remaining spec-silent behaviors a reasonable user would hit.

OUTPUT: ### Strengths; ### Issues (#### Critical/Important/Minor with file:line+why+fix); ### Recommendations; ### Assessment (Ready: Yes/No/With fixes + reason). Before verdict list out-of-scope items one line each with reason. Read-only: mutate nothing, spawn no subagents.
